params.prompt: A Rajasthani folk singer performing in heavy rain, his mouth driven by the audio. The size of his mouth opening follows the loudness of the voice at every moment — barely parted when soft, wide only at the loudest points, easing shut between phrases. Rain runs off his turban and beard; drops streak past the lens; his throat and chest work with the breath. His bow hand stays still and resting near the instrument's bowl — he is singing, not bowing, and the bow never crosses the strings; the long decorated pole of the instrument stays exactly as in the start frame. Locked-off camera, no pan or zoom, single continuous take. Everything else exactly as the start frame. Photoreal, cinematic.
